description: Exact (rational) optimal-face characterisation of the a_K operator-selection LP posed by aK_via_lp_dual_full.py. For every primal and dual coordinate, min and max over the optimal face. Tests whether u_lambda* is identified on y_lambda = 0 rows (beans qou-ssf9, qou-fu8c); predictions pre-registered in PREREGISTRATION.md.

parameters.inputs: chi-*-at-q0-50dps.witness.json (proton q0), decimal strings read exactly

checks.atom: helium-4 [l>=3 set to exact 0, convention D arm]

atoms.atom: helium-4 [l>=3 set to exact 0, convention D arm]

caveats: The LP's own data are the decimal strings in the chi caches. The producer passes them to Clarabel through float64 (np.array), so the LP it actually solves differs in the last digits of the nonzero |c|; zeros stay zero, so the face structure reported here is unchanged.
